SELECT DISTINCT candidates.id,candidates.hub_id FROM (
  SELECT w.id,w.hub_id
  FROM wfc_scale.hub_native_subscription s
  JOIN wfc_scale.hub_workflow w ON w.id=s.workflow_id
  JOIN wfc_scale.hub_native_event e ON e.hub_id=w.hub_id AND e.event_name=s.event_name AND e.event_key=s.event_key
  WHERE w.execution_mode=$2 AND w.native_status IN ($3,$4)
    AND e.effective_at>=s.as_of AND e.effective_at<=now()
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT $5 FROM wfc_scale.hub_native_inbox i WHERE i.workflow_id=w.id
      AND i.pointer_id=s.pointer_id AND i.kind=$6 AND (NOT i.consumed OR i.source_key=e.id::text)

WITH RECURSIVE ready AS (
    (SELECT hub_id FROM wfc_scale.hub_task
     WHERE state=$1 AND due_at<=now()
     ORDER BY hub_id LIMIT $2)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT next.hub_id
    FROM ready previous
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT hub_id FROM wfc_scale.hub_task
        WHERE hub_id>previous.hub_id AND state=$3 AND due_at<=now()
        ORDER BY hub_id LIMIT $4
    ) next
), expired AS (
    (SELECT hub_id FROM wfc_scale.hub_task
     WHERE state=$5 AND lease_until<now() AND attempts<max_attempts
     ORDER BY hub_id LIMIT $6)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT next.hub_id
    F

UPDATE wfc_scale.hub_workflow w
SET state=$1,completed_at=now(),updated_at=now(),
    last_error=$2
WHERE w.state IN ($3,$4) AND EXISTS (
    SELECT $5 FROM wfc_scale.hub_task t
    WHERE t.workflow_id=w.id AND t.workflow_step IS NOT NULL
      AND t.state=$6
)

WITH expired AS (UPDATE wfc_scale.hub_task SET state=$1, owner=$2, lease_until=$3,
    updated_at=now(), last_error=coalesce(last_error,$4)
WHERE state=$5 AND lease_until<now() AND attempts>=max_attempts RETURNING id),
closed AS (
  UPDATE wfc_scale.hub_task_attempt a SET finished_at=clock_timestamp(),outcome=$6
  FROM expired e WHERE a.task_id=e.id AND a.finished_at IS NULL RETURNING a.task_id
) SELECT count(*) FROM expired

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity
        WHERE datname=current_database()),
       (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity
        WHERE datname=current_database() AND state=$1),
       (SELECT count(*) FROM wfc_scale.hub_task WHERE state=$2 AND due_at<=now()),
       (SELECT count(*) FROM wfc_scale.hub_task WHERE state=$3 AND lease_until>now()),
       (SELECT count(*) FROM wfc_scale.hub_task WHERE state=$4)

SELECT hub_id,task_type,task_version,partition_id
FROM wfc_scale.hub_task
WHERE attempts < max_attempts AND
      ((state=$6 AND due_at<=now()) OR
      (state=$7 AND lease_until<now()))
  AND ($1 OR (hub_id,task_type,task_version,partition_id) >
      ($2,$3,$4,$5))
GROUP BY hub_id,task_type,task_version,partition_id
ORDER BY hub_id,task_type,task_version,partition_id
LIMIT $8
